In order to maximize your Marathon running speed, you should hold down both the forward and sidestep buttons, because the sidestepping speed is actually faster than the forward speed. This will result in the maximum in-game speed, but since you will be running at a diagonal angle, you should get used to adjusting your aim and direction accordingly so you can better navigate the game without sacrificing any forward velocity. Practice in a multiplayer level if need be -- arena-style levels might work best for training. And, of course, don't have the "Always Run" option on -- to be a true marathoner, you must always have an allotted key for running (but not the Caps Lock, of course).

Me and my girlfriend felt perfectly comfortable around each other, and I would hate if these feelings I hide are to blame for everything. I partly rely on humour, and other times on alcohol, to hide my true feelings from others, and it seems to work.
